 The old name of Almaty is Almaty, which means apples in Turkish, because it was famous for growing apple trees.It is the cultural center of Kazakhstan, because it combines authenticity and modernity, as there are landmarks of history mixed with the modern city, and it embraces the culture of the Kazakh people. The city of Almaty is located in southeastern Kazakhstan, in a mountainous region on the border with Kyrgyzstan. It is the largest and most beautiful city in Kazakhstan, because it has a charming green nature, as a result of its presence at the foot of the Tian Shan Mountain, and its location led to making it a crossroads for trade, so it is also considered a financial center with its resources that were an attractive factor for entrepreneurs and merchants, which led to its economic recovery.  The tourism experience in Almaty is not complete without tasting the Kazakh taste. Try the famous local dishes, such as beshbarmak, which is a mixture of boiled meat served with pasta, and Czech sauce made from meat broth and onions. Their local dishes are usually based mainly on horse meat, then lamb. Also try kazi, pilaf and kazman among the traditional dishes, and among the drinks try horse milk, koumiss and choban, and the traditional dessert is chowk chowk. Among the restaurants that focus on providing traditional Kazakh taste at reasonable prices is Alma Restaurant, and Shehrazade Restaurant serves Kazakh and Eastern recipes, and is a good choice for Muslims. Arab travelers.  If you do not prefer to try a Kazakh restaurant, here is the Cuisinart Restaurant, which offers high-quality oriental and international recipes. In addition to Aura Restaurant, Uzbekistan Restaurant, and Sweet Shawarma, which serves food made from shawarma, as well as Al Mutahida, Afgan, and Shahrazad Restaurants, all of which serve halal foods that are suitable for Arabs and Muslims.  there are many Tourist places in AlmatyYou can choose between them according to your goal of the trip, whether it is exploration and adventure, or relaxation. Likewise, if your trip is for a family with children, with friends, or for a honeymoon. The reason for the popularity of the Almaty Mountains is the picturesque landscapes and the adventures they provide, such as climbing and cycling, in addition to skiing on Mount Shymbulak, and riding the cable car, and all of these activities are about 30 minutes away from the city. The most famous street is Arbat Street, which is a very old and lively street. It contains a large number of restaurants, cafes and elegant clothing stores. The life there shows Kazakh culture, and you can also buy souvenirs and sit in the surrounding restaurants to try food from traditional Kazakh cuisine. The infrastructure of Almaty was designed taking into account the health of children and providing places for play and fun, which is why you see in every neighborhood a designated area for children and teenagers, full of different types of beautiful games, at the highest level of security and very clean. There is also the Almaty Zoo, which includes more than 6,000 living creatures of different species, and it is a distinguished place to open the child’s minds, and at the same time bring pleasure to all family members, by taking a walk in the largest park in Kazakhstan and enjoying the natural sounds and seeing its beauty. In addition to other entertainment places, such as parks, amusement parks, and museums suitable for children. Choosing the right time to visit Almaty depends on your preference. There are also ice skating and dog sledding competitions.
